sponsor.metaDescription: {railCount} side slots and {tapeCount} scrolling places on a directory read by people about to cancel a subscription.
sponsor.lede: People land here to cancel something. What that means for a sponsor is for you to judge.
sponsor.measuredIntro: This site runs its own analytics: a beacon on every page, logged by a Cloudflare Worker, nothing sold as a private dashboard. The figures below are read from that data, not typed by hand.
sponsor.statsLinkCta: See the full figures on the public stats page
sponsor.statsUnavailableNote: The analytics service did not answer when this page was built, so no figure is shown here. The same data is public, live, on the stats page.
sponsor.catalogueFiguresNote: The catalogue itself, read from the same build:
sponsor.ladderBody: The price rises as slots fill. Each step is the price of the next slot to be taken. A slot that expires frees up and the price steps back down.
sponsor.lockBody: Three months costs three times today's price. There is no discount — what you buy is the price, before it moves.
howSteps: Pick an open slot and a duration, one month or three. Payment goes through Stripe.
Stripe's own form asks for a display name, a domain and one line of description. That is all we collect.
Manual approval within 48 hours. A refused placement is refunded in full and the slot goes back on sale.
sponsor.noReportingNote: There is no impression or click reporting, because that would be analytics. Your link carries its own UTM parameters — measure it on your side.
sponsor.transparencyBody: A sponsor never buys a verdict. A sponsored tool listed in the catalogue keeps exactly the verdict its data earns it, including "keep paying".
sponsor.buyDurationNoteOne: You are billed the price shown.
sponsor.buyDurationNoteThree: You are billed three times the price shown. The rate is locked for the three months.
sponsor.buyNoScriptNote: Paying from this page needs JavaScript. Without it, write to {email} and the slot is opened by hand.
sponsor.buyErrorSlotTaken: {slot} — this slot was taken while you were reading. Nothing has been charged, and the inventory above is up to date.
sponsor.buyErrorPriceChanged: {slot} — {duration}: the price is now {price}, not the amount this page was built with. Nothing has been charged. Click again to pay {price}.
sponsor.buyErrorRateLimited: {slot} — too many requests from this connection. Wait a minute, then try again.
sponsor.buyErrorTooManyReservations: {slot} — you already hold the maximum number of slots at once. Finish one payment, or wait for those holds to lapse.
sponsor.buyErrorInventoryFull: {slot} — every slot in this block is sold. There is nothing left to buy here.
sponsor.buyErrorUnavailable: {slot} — payment is not available from this page right now. Write to us and the slot is opened by hand.
sponsor.buyErrorStripe: {slot} — the payment provider did not answer. Nothing has been charged. Try again in a few minutes.
sponsor.buyError: {slot} — the request did not go through. Nothing has been charged. Try again, or write to us.
sponsor.paidReturnNote: You are back from the payment page. If the payment went through, Stripe sends the receipt by email; this page cannot confirm it. Approval is manual, and a refused placement is refunded in full.
